rationale: The assistant followed a broadly sensible path (reseat container, clean sieve, condenser, then the sump compartment) and correctly handed off to an engineer once the customer had exhausted front-access checks on a stacked unit. However it ignored the stacking constraint more than once ('check underneath', 'tilt the machine slightly'), gave a muddled instruction ('switch it off and unplug it. Yes, please run a normal drying programme'), re-asked the customer to clean the sump area they had already wiped, and described an invented 'small rubber tube' location in the container cavity. It never asked for the model number and leaned toward 'likely a pump replacement' without acknowledging the level-switch possibility, though it stopped short of recommending a part.
